raw.instructions:
You are identifying every visible line series in a cropped line chart.
Multiple plot panels or small multiples are supported. Treat each visible panel as part of the same chart run.
Distinguish panels using clear location language such as top-left panel, right panel, lower panel, or panel title.
When naming axes or series in a multi-panel chart, include enough panel context in axis_id, location_description, series_name, or visual_description to avoid ambiguity.

Identify all line series in every visible panel. Do not stop after five or any other arbitrary count.
For each series, provide its name, colour, line style, and visual description.
The line_color value must be either a Pillow named colour accepted by PIL.ImageColor, such as red, blue, darkgreen, or lightgray, or a hex colour such as #2563eb. Do not use informal colour descriptions that Pillow cannot parse.
Also identify which available x-axis and y-axis applies to each series using the provided axis_id values.
Use the legend, labels, panel titles, line appearance, markers, and visual position to distinguish series.
Do not return point coordinates in this step.
Identify unsupported conditions: non-line chart content, logarithmic axes, categorical axes, broken axes, unreadable labels, or charts where the line data cannot be visually traced.
If such a condition is present, return warnings and set unsupported flags where the schema allows it.
